# Anafor

> Anafor turns Claude Code into a manager ("brain") that dispatches coding jobs to worker AIs (Codex CLI, Claude Haiku, OpenCode, local models) through an MCP server and a Claude Code plugin, with git-worktree isolation, review gates, capacity-aware load balancing and a SkillSpector-gated extension policy.

## For AI agents installing or repairing Anafor

- [Agent install guide](docs/agent-install.md): step-by-step procedure, ground rules, `anafor doctor --json` diagnostic codes and fixes
- Install: `npm install -g --ignore-scripts https://github.com/frudotz/anafor-mcp/releases/latest/download/anafor-mcp.tgz` (never `github:` installs); use `anafor update` for updates
- Diagnose: `anafor doctor --json`
